nodes.label: Commerce Business Rules
nodes.rationale: Cross-system rules must be short, testable, linked to affected systems, and mapped to acceptance criteria.

nodes.label: Maintainable Industrial E-Commerce Platform
nodes.rationale: Every module should support a growing commerce platform with clear ownership, traceable rules, and room for operational expansion.

nodes.label: Custom Laravel Admin Decision
nodes.rationale: A custom Blade-based Laravel admin provides long-term flexibility, low vendor lock-in, simple customization, control over business flows, and AI-friendly code generation.

nodes.label: Standard Laravel Structure Decision
nodes.rationale: Preserving standard Laravel roots avoids a redundant source wrapper and establishes responsibility-based Actions, Queries, Policies, and constrained Services.

nodes.label: Execution-Ready Work
nodes.rationale: Implementation tasks must be traceable to business goals, modules, entities, API or UI surfaces, and acceptance criteria.

nodes.label: Task Promotion Gate
nodes.rationale: Backlog items become development tasks only after traceability and acceptance criteria exist.

nodes.label: Stability Before Expansion
nodes.rationale: The roadmap prioritizes a stable, correct business foundation before advanced expansion and automation.

nodes.label: API Readiness Contract
nodes.rationale: API entries must identify actor, permission, request fields, response needs, and acceptance criteria before development.

nodes.label: Background Work Contract
nodes.rationale: Queue jobs must define retry, idempotency, and failure behavior before implementation.

nodes.label: Field Approval Contract
nodes.rationale: A database field is approved only when its entity, purpose, type direction, validation need, and consuming UI or API surface are known.
